svg.text: Short retention trials: preserve the full perimeter, remove long walls
Blue = base, orange = cap. Actual CAD: left = XY at catches/rails; right = section through the gripping recess.
R1-S broad-wall snap
77 × 51.2 mm XY; 24 mm overlap; 42 mm assembled.
Base band: 6 mm. Recessed seam gap: 3 mm.
Corners still seat the cap; catches and ramps unchanged.
Shorter walls change stiffness: earlier force values do not transfer.
R2-S end-wall snap
77 × 51.2 mm XY; 24 mm overlap; 42 mm assembled.
Base band: 6 mm. Recessed seam gap: 3 mm.
Corners still seat the cap; catches and ramps unchanged.
Shorter walls change stiffness: earlier force values do not transfer.
R3-S perimeter bead
77 × 51.2 mm XY; 24 mm overlap; 42 mm assembled.
Base band: 6 mm. Recessed seam gap: 3 mm.
Corners still seat the cap; catches and ramps unchanged.
Shorter walls change stiffness: earlier force values do not transfer.
R4-S shallow rail trial
77 × 70 mm XY; assembled height 14.2 mm.
Open-bottom base: 12.2 mm high, formerly 49.2 mm.
Front recess exposes the lid underside for sliding.
Rails/detents unchanged; shallow tray stiffness is different.
These test fit, snap/recovery and grip access with less material. Full-box guidance, force and ergonomics require re-checking.
